issues.title: Show geometry when a set of orders is expanded
issues.body:
When we expand the detail on a set of orders, we should show the geometries for the orders.

But, we need to `intercept` the `editActivity` call, and switch off the geometry - since the editable version is about to appear.

Similarly, when the new geometry is saved, we should switch to rendering the `draft` geometry.  On `Save` or `Cancel` we just drop the rendered geometry.
